name: Answers in Italian
effect: Replies in Italian (sometimes Spanish) to English prompts, including Italian poems about 'Il Mare' and interview tips. It also has a tic of 'Non, non, non...' (even 'Nonna, nonna...') and is often vague or confused about what was asked.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
